remarks: Executive Condo in the heart of Downtown Edmonton. This 1 bedroom unit is centrally located within walking distance of Grant McEwan, LRT, the River Valley, shopping, parks, and public transit.  Open floor plan, 9 ft ceilings and a corner gas fireplace will keep you warm on those cold winter days. There is a cozy yet spacious feel to the home. East facing windows allow ample natural light particularly in the mornings! The open floor plan has a huge modern kitchen, and island bar overlooking the dining area and great room.  . There is space for dining and office area. Master bedroom is huge and features double closets with organizers,.Main bathroom is quite large and features extensive cabinetry. Additional features include in-suite laundry, 9 ft ceilings, air conditioning, underground parking and additional storage locker, fully equipped modern gym, board room, and massive foyer with sitting area.
